subject: Confirmation RE: Public Records Request No. 26-045612
acknowledgment_text:
Dear Mr. Puglisi:

The Office of Insurance Regulation is in receipt of your Public Records Request.

Your request is being processed. Any responsive documents will be provided to you via email or secure link. Your request has been assigned tracking number 26-045612. Please reference this tracking number in any correspondence.

Records containing information that is exempt from public records will be provided in redacted form. Requests requiring a significant staff time may require the payment of the reasonable costs incurred by the Office to produce the requested records. For voluminous requests, requesters are required to pay a deposit prior to the retrieval of the records.

If there is a charge associated with your request, you will receive an itemized invoice that must be paid prior to the release of any documents.

Please note that the Office receives a large volume of public records requests and seeks to field them in the order received. We are currently fulfilling older requests while we continue to receive and log new ones.

Sincerely,
